definition: The ability to influence a situation or use something to your advantage.
example: She used her experience to gain leverage in the negotiation.

definition: Able to be trusted to do something well or correctly.
example: He is a reliable colleague who always meets deadlines.

definition: To succeed in doing or obtaining something.
example: She worked hard to achieve her goals.

definition: To make something better or become better.
example: I want to improve my English skills.

definition: To keep something at the same level or in good condition.
example: It is important to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

definition: A difficult task or situation that requires effort or skill.
example: Learning a new programming language can be a challenge.

definition: To need something or make something necessary.
example: This project requires careful planning.

definition: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.
example: We need a more efficient way to process the data.

definition: To believe something is true without having proof.
example: I assumed that the application would work correctly.

definition: To stay away from something or prevent it from happening.
example: You should avoid making the same mistake twice.

definition: A way of dealing with a problem or situation.
example: We need a different approach to solve this problem.

definition: To succeed in completing something, especially through effort.
example: The team accomplished the task ahead of schedule.

definition: Correct and without mistakes.
example: The program produces accurate results.

definition: To improve the quality, value, or strength of something.
example: The update enhances the user experience.

definition: The final result of an action or process.
example: The outcome of the experiment was surprising.

definition: To change in order to suit new conditions or situations.
example: Developers must adapt to new technologies.

definition: To stop something from happening.
example: Automated tests help prevent software bugs.

definition: Important or large enough to have an effect.
example: The new feature resulted in a significant improvement.

definition: To get something, especially through effort or a process.
example: You need permission to obtain access to the system.

definition: To help cause something or give something to achieve a result.
example: Everyone can contribute to the success of the project.
